name: top.copy/mcp
title: copy.top
description: Smart money tracker: top traders' PnL, live trades and alerts on Solana, pump.fun and Hyperliquid.

tools.name: search
tools.description: find traders and coins on copy.top by name, handle, @x, $ticker or address. use it to resolve a name before the other tools.

tools.name: get_trader
tools.description: a trader's copy.top profile, like a wallet tracker (fomo or pump.fun): pnl 30d (realized, unrealized, total), roi, win rate, fair play verdict and badges, followers, copiers, platforms, largest open positions, latest trades and theses. to follow the new trades of several traders, use get_live_trades with traders instead.

handle.description: the trader's handle, as search or another tool gave it

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: the pnl leaderboard of top traders (fomo and pump.fun wallets), ranked like copy.top's discover page. window 1d, 7d or 30d; sort total (pnl), realized, roi, winrate or copiers; optional chain or platform (fomo, pumpfun); fair_play clean or clean_or_watch keeps only those.

chain.description: chain id as the tools give it

tools.name: get_token
tools.description: a coin's copy.top page: price, market cap, 1h and 24h moves, liquidity, which tracked traders hold it or sold it and their pnl on it, and their theses.

chain.description: chain id as the tools give it

tools.name: get_theses
tools.description: the latest or most popular theses (a trader's written reason for holding a coin) posted by tracked traders in the last 24 h at most, with the coin and their pnl at post.

limit.description: rows to return, default 10. ask for fewer to get a shorter answer

tools.name: get_hot_coins
tools.description: the signal feed: coins tracked traders are buying now. window 1h or 24h, optional max market cap in dollars. each coin: how many traders and top traders bought, dollars bought and sold, minutes since the first buy, and the first buyers.

limit.description: rows to return, default 15. ask for fewer to get a shorter answer

tools.name: get_live_trades
tools.description: the live tape: the latest buys and sells by tracked traders (fomo and pump.fun), newest first. to follow a watchlist, pass traders (up to 25 handles) and the cursor of the previous call as since, once a minute: one call returns every new trade of those traders, instead of reading each profile. also side buy or sell, min_usd.

since.description: iso time, e.g. the cursor from the previous call

traders.description: only these traders: handles from search or the leaderboard, up to 25

limit.description: rows to return, default 30. ask for fewer to get a shorter answer

tools.name: get_alerts
tools.description: events since a cursor, for alert bots: confluence (several top traders bought the same coin recently), big_trade (one tracked trader bought or sold a large amount) and thesis (a tracked trader posted a thesis). pass the cursor of the previous call as since; without since, the last 15 minutes. thresholds are yours.

since.description: the cursor of the previous call (iso time)

min_trade_usd.description: big trade threshold in dollars, default 5000

max_mcap_usd.description: ignore coins above this market cap

limit.description: rows to return, default 40. ask for fewer to get a shorter answer

tools.name: get_hot_index
tools.description: copy.top's hot index: coins ranked 0-100 by attention right now, mixing tracked traders buying, callers and x activity (voices, views). window 1h, 6h or 24h; optional chain.

chain.description: chain id as the tools give it

limit.description: rows to return, default 10. ask for fewer to get a shorter answer

tools.name: get_money_flow
tools.description: where tracked traders' dollars go: coins ranked by dollars bought (side buy) or sold (side sell) over 1h, 6h, 24h or 7d, with the number of traders.

limit.description: rows to return, default 10. ask for fewer to get a shorter answer

tools.name: get_dex_paid
tools.description: coins whose team paid for a dexscreener profile in the last 24 h (a sign the team is spending), with price, market cap, liquidity, volume and moves.

limit.description: rows to return, default 12. ask for fewer to get a shorter answer

tools.name: hl_get_traders
tools.description: rank hyperliquid perps traders tracked by copy.top. window 24h, 7d, 30d or all; sort pnl or roi. each row: address, name, account value, pnl, roi, volume, win rate, style, trades per day, max drawdown 30d, top coins.

tools.name: hl_get_trader
tools.description: a hyperliquid trader by address: profile and metrics (win rate, profit factor, drawdown, usual leverage, score), pnl per window, open positions with entry, size, leverage and liquidation price, and latest fills.

tools.name: hl_get_markets
tools.description: live hyperliquid markets (crypto perps and hip-3: stocks, indices, commodities, fx): mark price, 24h change, 24h volume, open interest, hourly funding, max leverage. optional category; sorted by 24h volume.

category.description: e.g. crypto, stocks, indices, commodities, fx

tools.name: hl_get_market_read
tools.description: copy.top's read of one major hyperliquid market: technicals (rsi, emas, trend), funding vs its history and other venues, premium, open interest changes, what the top 300 traders hold and their latest moves, nearby liquidations, fear and greed.

tools.name: hl_get_calls
tools.description: x analysts ranked by the track record of their calls on one hyperliquid market, and their recent calls.
